checked_invariants.name: synthetic isolation
checked_invariants.finding: Every record must match the declared synthetic/live dataset kind.

checked_invariants.name: system time ordering and review timestamps
checked_invariants.finding: Retrieval no later than known time; known/review no later than export; reviewed timestamp required for validated/reviewed states.

checked_invariants.name: named human reviewer
checked_invariants.finding: human_verified requires reviewer_ref; target must resolve to person actor at line 146.

checked_invariants.name: publication and content-rights gates
checked_invariants.finding: Eligible requires human verification and cleared rights; statement text/excerpts need redistribution clearance.

checked_invariants.name: reference closure, types and knowledge ordering
checked_invariants.finding: All exact references must resolve in bundle, target allowed types, and not refer to future knowledge; actor-specific checks apply.

checked_invariants.name: revision lineage
checked_invariants.finding: supersedes must be immediate preceding revision of same ID with strictly later known_at; revision 1 cannot supersede.

checked_invariants.name: time ranges, numerical intervals and bounds
checked_invariants.finding: Additional range, interval, quantile, numeric-domain and bound checks beyond field shape.

checked_invariants.name: measurement semantics
checked_invariants.finding: Numeric or missing results, matching units, declared metric scales and nonempty bounds.

checked_invariants.name: currency basis
checked_invariants.finding: Resource currency fields follow unit and basis constraints.

checked_invariants.name: translation and collective identity
checked_invariants.finding: Original translation lineage, collective population metadata and translated statement original evidence checks.

not_established: Whether any original acceptance case would pass a native validator
Whether source text is truthful or a claim has independent outcome verification
Whether a legal instrument was effective or a remedy completed
Whether source-local subjects or cohorts identify the same entities
Whether an incident taxonomy, cluster or severity choice is valid
Whether production Zod helpers or database ingestion would accept proposed records

production_static_notes.finding: Required person_slug; no organization_slug field on statement. Institution attribution cannot be mapped directly.
Requires content_hash or content_hash_input; mandatory observed_at timestamp. Source-byte hash meaning is not automatically interchangeable with any future importer content canonicalization.
Permits organization_slug and/or person_slug, but does not relax statementSchema.
Production contract 1.0.0 is distinct from proposed pdataset 0.1.0.
